name: red-tide-ppc
description: Community-driven red tide (PSP) advisory and reporting map for Puerto Princesa, Palawan

paragraphs: Community-driven red tide (PSP) advisory map and report tracker for the coastal waters of Puerto Princesa, Palawan.

A public map of coastal zones colour-coded by advisory status, an anonymous way for anyone on the water to report what they are seeing, and a passcode-gated admin view that turns a credible report into a zone-wide advisory.

For the school presentation, see Presentation review. For the optional virtual ESP32, see Virtual device setup. The separate /devices page supports local rehearsal without accounts or hardware. On the first visit per device and intro version (remembered in localStorage), / opens with a short wave intro over the landing page. Escape skips it, and prefers-reduced-motion skips it entirely; ↻ in the landing header reopens it. The public map retains its original animated zone and advisory drawers.
features: Symptoms usually begin 30 minutes to 2 hours after eating.
It starts as tingling or numbness around the mouth, tongue and face, then spreads to the arms and legs.
Severe cases progress to respiratory paralysis and can be fatal within 12 hours.
There is no antidote. Treatment is supportive care — keeping the person breathing until the toxin wears off.
